hero.title: Earn PPL with PEOPLE
hero.lead: One place for your founder number, points, personal referral link, bounties and the community reward pool.
hero.disclaimer: Testnet stage. Points and rewards are preliminary, require human verification and are not a promise of income.

countdown.title: Countdown to the PPL sale
countdown.lead: The public PPL sale opens on 1 December 2026. You pay in USDC or USDT on Base, and PPL are credited immediately to your address in the PEOPLE network.
countdown.unavailable: The opening date has not been announced.

stats.title: Participants
stats.missing: Participant data is not available right now.

leaderboard.title: Top ambassadors
leaderboard.lead: Ranked by verified invitees. Bots and unverified accounts do not count.
leaderboard.missing: The leaderboard has no real data yet.

tasks.title: Your points and tasks
tasks.lead: Points are awarded for real actions after human verification. Buying PPL and joining airdrops are not rewarded.
tasks.notFounder: Sign in and claim a founder number to start earning points.

referral.title: Invite people, earn from the Growth Pool
referral.lead: Two levels: L1 for direct invitees and L2 for their invitees. Points are credited only for verified invitees who take a real action.
referral.l2Value: {{percent}} of the L1 invitee's referral points (L2)
referral.vestingValue: 10% immediately, the rest over 52 weeks, conditional on activity.
referral.signIn: Sign in and claim a founder number to get your personal link.
referral.growthNote: Growth referral payouts come from the Growth Pool: 15% of eligible network fees. L1 and L2 weights are 70/30 of that budget.

bounties.title: Bounties
bounties.lead: Extra ways to earn PPL from the Community & rewards pool.
bounties.bugBody: Report a vulnerability or a product bug with the bug button on any page. Accepted reports are rewarded in founder points.
bounties.creatorBody: Issuers may reserve an optional 5% of supply (maximum 10%) for invite rewards, with a default invite bounty of 5% of the invitee's purchase.
bounties.contentBody: Follow the task board and announcements. A new bounty is added only when it has a real budget and rules.

tokenomics.title: Where every reward comes from
tokenomics.lead: Rewards are paid only from the Community & rewards pool. No new PPL is minted for them.
tokenomics.vestingValue: 10% immediately, the rest over 12 months, conditional on activity.

personal.title: Founder dashboard
personal.lead: Your number, points, referral link and tasks update automatically.

final.title: Ready to earn PPL?
final.lead: Claim a founder number, complete tasks and invite verified people.
